Nearmap coverage (1 metadata lookup):

Lots are colored by status. Red outline = proposed priority lot for a Nearmap AI pass. Click a lot for its fire context. Entry, gate and water points are leads, marked UNCONFIRMED where no person or viewer has confirmed them.

Security

  • Gated community: OSM gate nodes at both Skyline Ranch Rd entries. The 2003 Declaration lists a gatehouse/entry security gate. Call box, cameras and Knox/Opticom are UNCONFIRMED. [access_osm_barriers, sec_hoa_declaration_summary]
  • A private gate on the north edge (OSM) may be an emergency exit (the Declaration mentions "emergency exit gates") UNCONFIRMED.
  • Police agency is DCSO (unincorporated county). Its offense rates are well below Oregon and US levels (agency-wide, not neighbourhood). [sec_fbi_cde]
  • About 40% of lots are flagged not owner-occupied (ATTOM), consistent with second homes. Census 2020 blocks wholly inside the Highlands: see the Community tab. Tract and block-group figures are not used because they take in Tetherow and Broken Top. [ATTOM property detail, Census 2020 blocks]
FBI Crime Data Explorer, 2024 offenses per 100k. Agency level.

Responder access and egress

  • First due: Station 301 West (district covers 100% of the community). Fire protection: RFPD #2 with Bend Fire & Rescue. [fire_bend_station_districts, fire_odf_fpd]
  • One private loop (Macalpine/Belmore) with two gated entries and five dead-end courts (about 230–260 m each). [access_osm_roads]
  • Evacuation zone ID not publicly queryable (Genasys Protect), so it needs a manual lookup UNCONFIRMED. There is a county permanent helicopter LZ "Macalpine Rd - Highlands @ Broken Top". [access_evac_zones, access_county_lz]
Modelled drive (OSRM, free-flow; not response time)

Assets

  • Hazard: large homes, open building sites and fire features on the 53 lots (A-H1, A-H2).
  • Concealment: big lots, vacant lots and the forest edge that hide homes and people from view (A-C1, A-C2).
  • Value: what the homes are worth and how often they change hands (A-V1, A-V2).

Roads, gates, evacuation, the landing zone and drive times are responder access and egress items. They are on the S tab under "Responder access and egress".

Fire

  • 83% of the community is in the mapped WUI, and 100% is in the county Wildfire Hazard Area. 12 lots touch Deschutes NF land. [fire_odf_wui, fire_county_whazard, fire_usfs_ownership]
  • WHP: 46% high, 43% moderate. Annual burn probability on the lots is 0.0020–0.0027 (about 1 in 400–500), with flame length up to 13 ft. [fire_whp_class, fire_wrc_bp, fire_wrc_cfl]
  • The 1990 Awbrey Hall fire perimeter covers about 86% of today's lots (pre-development). [fire_odf_historic]
  • No hydrant inside the community. The nearest are on Skyline Ranch Rd and the north edge (median 406 m from homes, max about 1.2 km). Water supply is private wells. Pond draft is UNCONFIRMED. [fire_county_hydrants]
  • Not a recognized Firewise USA site (neighbours are). [fire_firewise_status]
FEMA National Risk Index, tract 41017001401, national percentile (50 = US median). Area-level.

Priority lots (proposal)

Credits = 48 per 1,000 m² of footprint plus a 30 m buffer, as an ESTIMATE. "proxy" = no mapped footprint, sized from ATTOM sq ft.

Environment (observations, not maintenance advice)

  • Open shrub/scrub (62%) with ponderosa pine (13% evergreen forest). Mean canopy is about 7.5%. Terrain is gentle (1–6° near homes). [env_nlcd_lc, env_nlcd_tcc, env_3dep_2m]
  • FEMA Zone X. The nearest A/AE flood zone is about 2.4 km away. [env_fema_nfhl]
  • On-site pond of about 0.9 ac (OSM). Private wells per public sources. [env_osm_water]
  • Smoke seasons: see AQI chart (Bend metro). [env_aqi_epa_cbsa]
EPA AirData annual AQI, Bend CBSA 13460: days at "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups" or worse.
